stories.summary: Prime Minister Evika Siliņa visited Kyiv on February 24 with other NB8 leaders to mark the war anniversary and reaffirm support. President Rinkēvičs delivered a video address calling for continued mobilization and warning the war's end will be neither quick nor easy.

stories.headline: President Rinkēvičs meets with Polish President Navrocki in Rīga
stories.summary: Latvian President Rinkēvičs hosted Polish President Karols Navrockis on February 27 for talks on defense cooperation, regional security, and bilateral relations. Both countries committed to maintaining 5% GDP defense spending.

stories.headline: Siliņa advocates for EU support to eastern border regions during Brussels visit
stories.summary: Prime Minister Siliņa visited Brussels on February 26 to advocate for targeted EU support for eastern border regions. She met with EU Commission President von der Leyen and European Council President Costa, emphasizing that Europe's security depends on a strong eastern border.

articles.title: Siliņa Briselē aicina Eiropas Savienību mērķēti atbalstīt austrumu pierobežas reģionus

stories.headline: Latvian officials respond to Middle East escalation and Iran strikes
stories.summary: Prime Minister Siliņa and other officials commented on escalating Middle East tensions. Siliņa stated Latvia is closely following developments and maintaining contact with colleagues in the EU. Defense Minister Sprūds said US-Israeli strikes targeted Iran's repressive regime, which is complicit in Russia's aggression against Ukraine.

stories.headline: Parliament rushes property protection law amendments after family's case
stories.summary: The Saeima fast-tracked amendments to property law to better protect honest buyers after the Stankevičs family case highlighted gaps in current protections. The family faces losing their home because it was purchased from a fraudster years ago.

stories.headline: Defense Minister Sprūds meets with new US Ambassador on bilateral cooperation
stories.summary: Defense Minister Andris Sprūds met with US Ambassador Melissa Argyros to discuss Latvia-US defense cooperation and regional security initiatives. They reaffirmed close cooperation as Latvia increases defense spending to 5% of GDP.

articles.title: Sprūds and U.S. Ambassador reaffirm close defense cooperation and strengthening of regional security

stories.headline: Government approves additional 293 hectares for anti-mobility infrastructure on eastern border
stories.summary: The Defense Ministry announced approval of 717 additional land parcels totaling 293.77 hectares for anti-mobility infrastructure construction on the eastern border. Defense Minister Sprūds said the first barriers will be installed in March.

articles.title: Pretmobilitātes infrastruktūras izveidei apstiprina vēl 293 hektārus pierobežā; martā sāks pirmo šķēršļu izvietošanu

stories.headline: Parliament advances national concert hall law despite lack of funding
stories.summary: The Saeima approved in first reading a law to establish the national concert hall 'Rīgas filharmonija.' The project will be built by Rīga municipality in cooperation with the Culture Ministry, though funding sources remain unclear.

articles.title: Saeima virza likumu par koncertzāles "Rīgas filharmonija" izveidi; pagaidām bez naudas seguma

stories.headline: Election system upgrades begin just seven months before parliamentary elections
stories.summary: Work on upgrading voting and ballot counting systems for the 15th Saeima elections began only in February, just seven months before the October vote. The procurement for election system improvements concluded in early February after previous system problems.

articles.title: Balsošanas sistēmu pilnveidošana sākas tikai septiņus mēnešus pirms Saeimas vēlēšanām
Saeima elections in Rīga will have 158 polling stations, including zoo

stories.headline: MP Jeļena Kļaviņa fined for insufficient state language skills
stories.summary: Several parliamentary factions are preparing a draft decision to send non-faction MP Jeļena Kļaviņa for a state language proficiency test. Media reports indicate she has been fined for insufficient Latvian language knowledge.

articles.title: Saeimas deputāte Jeļena Kļaviņa sodīta par nepietiekamām valsts valodas zināšanām

stories.headline: President Rinkēvičs supports rehabilitation of Soviet-era psychiatric repression victims
stories.summary: President Rinkēvičs believes the Saeima should adopt a political declaration rehabilitating people unjustifiably placed in psychiatric institutions during Soviet repressions. He met with Justice Minister Lībiņa-Egnere to discuss the issue.

articles.title: Rinkēvičs atbalsta PSRS represiju rezultātā psihiatriskajās iestādēs nepamatoti ievietoto cilvēku reabilitāciju

stories.headline: Czech President Pavel to visit Latvia in March
stories.summary: President Rinkēvičs will host Czech President Petr Pavel and his wife Eva Pavlová on a state visit March 10-11. Discussions will focus on bilateral relations, defense cooperation, regional security, and transatlantic relations.

articles.title: Latviju apmeklēs Čehijas prezidents Pavels

stories.headline: New party 'Development of Latvia' to compete in parliamentary elections
stories.summary: The party 'Latvijas attīstībai' (Development of Latvia) announced it will participate in the upcoming Saeima elections. The party criticized the current government for avoiding difficult decisions and failing to inspire public trust.

articles.title: "Latvijas attīstībai" startēs Saeimas vēlēšanās

stories.headline: Siliņa discusses Rheinmetall investment at Munich Security Conference
stories.summary: Prime Minister Siliņa met with Rheinmetall CEO Armin Papperger at the Munich Security Conference, thanking him for investments in Latvia's security and economic growth. The article discusses Rheinmetall's expansion into the Baltics amid different approaches by the three countries.

articles.title: Spīlēs starp politiku un izdevīgumu. Kā "Rheinmetall" ienāk Baltijā

stories.headline: Foreign Minister Braže emphasizes need for more agile NATO capabilities
stories.summary: Foreign Minister Baiba Braže stressed that NATO must become more capable of action according to geopolitical reality. She also reported Latvia has contributed 17.2 million euros to NATO's PURL initiative for critical defense procurement from the US.

articles.title: NATO jākļūst rīcībspējīgākai, uzsver Braže

stories.headline: Latvian Police assist in shutting down fraud network in Ukraine
stories.summary: Latvia's State Police, cooperating with foreign law enforcement agencies, helped shut down an organized crime network operating fraudulent call centers in Ukraine. The operation resulted in arrests and investigation of investment fraud schemes.

articles.title: Latvian police help bust fraud network in Ukraine

stories.headline: Suspended judge continues working as judicial assistant despite fraud conviction
stories.summary: A judge who was convicted of fraud and suspended from office continues to work as a judicial assistant. The case involves allegations of fictitious employment of an archivist who received salaries, bonuses and awards for work not performed.
